title: CommandReceipt
description: control-plane-parity.md 5.2. Acceptance is not execution: `accepted` means the command is durable and will be worked, not that it has happened. `unknown` is required, not optional: conversation-engine.md §3.5 `ChannelAdapter` fixes the receipt vocabulary — its words are `SendReceipt.status = accepted|delivered|failed|unknown` — and §7.3 报价/订单 saga forbids collapsing an unconfirmed outcome into a confirmed one: 「没有可靠 inverse 时保持 UNKNOWN/manual，不伪造回滚成功」, while parity 5.2 requires a receipt for every external channel action. Mapping: SendReceipt accepted|delivered -> succeeded; SendReceipt failed -> failed; SendReceipt unknown and IntentRecord UNKNOWN -> unknown, resolved by the delivery reconcile path, which is also what raises the manual task.
